title: carpha capitellata var. bracteosa
intro: Carpha capitellata var. bracteosa, commonly known as the bracted carpha, is a plant species that belongs to the family Poaceae. The bracted carpha has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the respiratory system, as well as its potential to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of the bracted carpha include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
